briefs.name: Knight Ruins
briefs.brief: A third-person action game where a knight fights skeletons in crumbling castle ruins. Swing the sword, dodge their attacks, and clear every room to win.

briefs.name: Neon Arena
briefs.brief: Top-down arena: you're a little hover tank in a glowing pit and waves of drones keep coming at you. Survive five waves.

briefs.name: Fox Cliffs
briefs.brief: A side-scrolling platformer where a fox runs and jumps across cliffs, collects berries and avoids hedgehogs, and reaches the den at the end of the level.

briefs.name: Crate Lab
briefs.brief: A puzzle game where a small robot pushes crates onto glowing pads in a lab. Three levels that get harder, with undo and restart.

briefs.name: Desert Kart
briefs.brief: A kart racing game on a desert track against three AI racers. Three laps, a boost pad or two, and you win by finishing first.

briefs.name: Seed Garden
briefs.brief: A cosy gardening game: plant seeds, water them, and harvest vegetables before the day ends. Sell the harvest to fill an order of ten vegetables.

briefs.name: Asteroid Gunner
briefs.brief: A space shooter where your ship flies through an asteroid field shooting rocks and alien fighters. Lose all three lives and it's over; beat the boss to win.

briefs.name: Drum Temple
briefs.brief: A rhythm game where notes slide down four lanes toward a temple drum and you hit the right key on the beat. Finish the song with enough hits to win, miss too many and you lose.

briefs.name: Tower Grove
briefs.brief: A tower defense game in a forest: goblins walk a winding path toward your village and you place archer towers to stop them. Survive ten waves.

briefs.name: Sky Runner
briefs.brief: An endless runner on floating sky islands: the runner switches between three lanes and jumps gaps and barriers. Reach 1000 metres to win, fall or hit a barrier and you lose.
